cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you cut the ribbon, whose bridge is this? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And who stopped it leaning into the river?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did. We thanked the engineers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Could one engineer have a name?

mechanism: A projects competent public leadership but adjusts how credit is requested to preserve B cooperation, needing B acknowledgment to sustain that authority.
confusable: Distinguish merely boasting from obtaining another person actual recognition, and distinguish insistence on rank from flexible face-saving accommodation.
comparison: Bridge opening seeks named engineering credit within communal ownership; wedding catering seeks personal announcement within event flow.
seedUse: Canonical bridge and buffet seeds provide withheld attribution; S02 should yield format or timing while maintaining leadership, not merely attach still-in-charge.
